description: StarPort BBS Intro by Future Crew, their first intro for StarPort, their home BBS, with AdLib music, running from its original files in your browser.
about: Future Crew's first intro for StarPort, their home BBS, released in September 1992: a scroller and AdLib music on a 640x350, 16-color graphics screen drawn to look like text.

StarPort BBS Intro II replaced it in November 1993; that intro's notes call it “a replacement for the ages old STARPRT2.EXE, which is completely out dated.” STARPRT2.EXE is the name Future Crew's release lists give this intro.
Any key ends it, leaving its advert above the DOS prompt.
released: Future Crew's release lists date it 13 September 1992, and its program is dated the same day.
credits: Code by Psi, music by Purple Motion.
terms: Its archive has no text of its own but scene.org's notice. Future Crew's information files make all their demos freeware: “you can copy and distribute them freely as long as you make no modifications to them.”
accuracy: Its AdLib music plays through the FM chip of the emulated Sound Blaster 16.
Not yet compared with a capture made on real hardware.
imageAlt: StarPort BBS Intro's space station, running in DosKit
